title: 第13章 进化法
content_zh:
第13章进化法
耗费了半小时，许景明将十本进化法都读了一遍，其实文字很少，进化法主要是一套复杂的锻炼动作，需要靠虚拟教学来学习。
十本进化法，都是以动物名字命名。
五本适合男性的进化法，汉字名字分别是《玄龟进化法》《天蟒进化法》《影豹进化法》《巨熊进化法》《暴虎进化法》，从名字上就能猜出这五种进化法不同的倾向。
“每本进化法，竟然都有契合度？”许景明有些惊讶，书籍上都标明契合度。
玄龟进化法（契合度71%），《天蟒进化法》（契合度98%），《影豹进化法》（契合度82%），《巨熊进化法》（契合度91%），《暴虎进化法》（契合度93%）。
至于五本女性进化法，契合度都不足50%。
“契合度，是根据你现实身体推算的结果，可以当做参考。”青衫男子说道，“最终还是要你练习进化法之后，做出选择。”
“在游戏世界内，你可以练习任何一种进化法，就算练得错漏百出，练得身体变弱或者变强。都可以进行重置，重置为现实身体。”青衫男子郑重提醒，“但现实中的学习，是没有后悔药的。现实中一旦确定进化路线，就只能沿着那一种进化法提升。游戏中也必须选同样的进化路线。”
“明白。”许景明微微点头，问道，“这五种进化法，都能治好我的腿伤吧？”
“这五种进化法，都能做到断肢重生，你这点小伤只要练习一两天就能完全治好。”青衫男子说道。
许景明微微点头。
生命的进化，真是神奇啊！这就是科技的魅力。
随即许景明点开个人面板，点击《玄龟进化法》的虚拟教学。
只见一个虚幻身体出现在峡谷中，开始在许景明面前练起了第一种基因进化法《玄龟进化法》。
许景明决定从低契合度一个个试验过去。
“每一招的速度、力度、节奏都有要求，还要和呼吸配合。”许景明刚开始练，就发现难度很高。
“招数也越来越快，呼吸也越来越快。”许景明配合着呼吸，只觉得心脏开始疼痛，全身皮肤都有火辣辣的感觉，终于练到中途。
“噗。”
许景明忍不住一口鲜血喷出。

“你已经受伤了。”一旁青衫男子说道。
“这比我学过的任何一种锻炼方法，都变态。”许景明捂着胸口，点击了一下个人面板，令身体恢复到巅峰状态。
游戏世界，不用担心受伤，因为随时可以恢复到巅峰状态。
“它的锻炼，甚至可以令基因变化，最终蜕变到更高的生命层次。”青衫男子说道，“难度当然高，所以才要让你们在虚拟世界里面学习。”
“再来。”许景明又一次尝试。
一次又一次。
整套动作，从缓慢到快，呼吸也是越来越快，心脏仿佛水泵般，越来越高强度工作。
因为种种原因，许景明一次次失败。
一直到第六次！
“哼。”最终收招，鼻孔喷出的气息都带着血色，那是血迹，但许景明终究是完成了一整套动作。
“恭喜你将《玄龟进化法》练到初阶水准，仅仅练六次就练成，真是了不起。”青衫男子说道。
许景明暗暗感慨。
自己可是世界顶尖武道选手，对身体的控制何等精准，都要练习六次才达到初阶水准。如果普通人，得多少次？一百次？三百次？
“多了一个战力面板？”许景明惊讶，发现个人面板下出现了一个子栏目——战力面板。
玩家：许景明
基因进化法：《玄龟进化法》（初阶1%）（练习时间不足一天，可提升）
身体：12（未学习进化法的成年男性，平均数值为5）
技能：暂无（请尽快进行实战，确定技能）
基础战力：暂无（请尽快进行实战）
“练习时间不足一天，可提升？”许景明看着那一行文字。

“在游戏世界，不需要像现实中一遍遍苦练，只要确定练会，就可以提升到身体极限。”青衫男子说道。
许景明试着点击提升。
“每天练习《玄龟进化法》三次，每次相隔至少一个小时。经过39天练习后，你的身体蜕变进化，身体指数达到39。”
“经过1051天练习后，你的身体进化到极限，身体指数达到53。”
“想要继续提升身体，请将《玄龟进化法》提升到中阶。”
许景明仅仅简单点击，就感觉自己的身体已然蜕变，胸背都宽阔厚实不少，整个人壮了许多，双臂双腿也更粗壮，举手投足间就有无比强大的力量。
许景明捡起峡谷中的一块鹅卵石，猛地一甩，甩出时，许景明只觉得整个人就仿佛一个大型工程器械，紧密的运转，猛然甩出那鹅卵石。
鹅卵石撕裂空气，留下一道气浪，撞击在远处岩壁上崩得碎裂，让许景明有些心惊。
许景明又捡起一块鹅卵石，右手略一用力，呼，鹅卵石捏得粉碎，碎渣缓缓从指缝中跌落。
“我现实中也能变成这样？”许景明低语。
“就像你战力面板提示你的，只要每天练习三次，在1051天后，你的现实身体就能提升到现在这样。”青衫男子说道，“这就是人类的进化。”
“这练武场，什么兵器铠甲都能选吗？”许景明查看着练武场的诸多功能，可以选兵器铠甲、陪练、战斗场景，功能繁多。
“蓝星历史上几乎所有冷兵器，这里都有。”青衫男子解释道。
许景明伸手一招，一杆长枪凭空出现：“重，再重些。”练武场是专门辅助修炼的，兵器重量也可自由调节。
右手一记单手刺枪，撕裂空气。
跟着许景明双手持枪，上前一步，粗壮的左臂握着枪把往前一送，噗噗噗！长枪化作幻影，连续刺出十余枪，有数条枪影残留在半空。
“施展枪法，有些别扭。”许景明看了下比过去粗壮一倍的手臂，整个人壮实太多了，“这身体太过笨拙了。”
“身体重置为现实肉身。”许景明轻轻一点，身体迅速变化，恢复到刚进入游戏时的状态，又变瘦了，腿伤也回到了身上，伤疤也回来了。
“下一种进化法。”许景明又开始了《影豹进化法》的虚拟教学。
如今全世界，无数人们都在认真学进化法。

练武场上。
许景明以惊人的速度，学会了其他四种进化法。
学了五次，便将《影豹进化法》提升到初阶，当练习时间提升到三年，许景明比现实中还精瘦不少，也无比灵活，百米跑，五秒时间就能跑完。
学了三次，《巨熊进化法》《暴虎进化法》就已练成。
《巨熊进化法》对身体影响最大，提升到身体极限后，许景明身高提高到一米九八，力大无穷，仿佛直立的大熊。《暴虎进化法》达到身体极限后，身高达到一米八五，也壮了些。
“仅仅练习一次，你就学会了《天蟒进化法》，不愧是契合度98%。”一旁青衫男子感慨道。
许景明在个人面板，将《天蟒进化法》练习时间提升到982天，也提升到身体极致。身高仅仅提高一厘米，但肌肉却比过去紧实许多，充满无尽韧性，自己的脊椎也仿佛一条大龙，能够将身体力道轻松传递。
“试试枪。”许景明站在岩壁前，手中长枪一动，便留下了一条条枪影，枪尖噗噗噗点在了峡谷岩壁上，一眨眼便刺出三十余枪，岩壁上刺出的窟窿形成了一个五角星。
许景明满意看着岩壁：“虚拟世界的推演，还真是厉害，《天蟒进化法》的确是最适合我的。”
“五种进化法，论力大，是巨熊进化法。论体质强壮是玄龟进化法。力量体质灵活各方面都比较强的，是暴虎进化法。速度最快最灵活的，是影豹进化法。但……身体韧性最强的，最契合我的，是天蟒进化法。”
“我练《天蟒进化法》也最为轻松，一次性就成功，身体提升也是最明显的。”许景明点头。
同样都是进化法初阶，提升到极限后。
唯有天蟒进化法，身体指数可以达到63，暴虎进化法是60，其它三种都是50多。如果去修炼契合度更低的女性进化法，估计身体指数还要更低。
“只要现实中没有开始练习，虚拟世界是随时可以重置的。”许景明想道，“就暂定《天蟒进化法》，先练几天再说。”
content_en:
Chapter 13 Evolution
It took Xu Jingming half an hour to read all ten books on the Evolution Method. In fact, there are very few words. The Evolution Method is mainly a set of complex exercises that require virtual teaching to learn.
The ten books on evolution are all named after animals.
There are five evolutionary methods suitable for men. The names in Chinese characters are "Black Turtle Evolution Method", "Sky Python Evolution Method", "Shadow Leopard Evolution Method", "Giant Bear Evolution Method" and "Violent Tiger Evolution Method". You can guess the different tendencies of these five evolutionary methods from the names.
"Each evolutionary method actually has a degree of compatibility?" Xu Jingming was a little surprised. The books all marked the degree of compatibility.
Black Turtle Evolution (71% fit), "Sky Python Evolution" (98% fit), "Shadow Leopard Evolution" (82% fit), "Giant Bear Evolution" (91% fit), "Violent Tiger Evolution" (93% fit).
As for the five female evolution methods, the fit is less than 50%.
"The fit is calculated based on your actual body and can be used as a reference." The man in the green shirt said, "In the end, you have to make a choice after practicing the evolutionary method."
"In the game world, you can practice any kind of evolution method. Even if you make mistakes during practice and your body becomes weaker or stronger, you can reset it and reset it to your real body." The man in green shirt solemnly reminded, "But there is no regret for learning in reality. Once the evolutionary route is determined in reality, you can only improve along that evolutionary method. You must choose the same evolutionary route in the game."
"Understood." Xu Jingming nodded slightly and asked, "Can these five evolutionary methods cure my leg injury?"
"These five evolutionary methods can all regenerate a broken limb. Your minor injury can be completely cured with just one or two days of practice." said the man in green shirt.
Xu Jingming nodded slightly.
The evolution of life is truly amazing! This is the charm of technology.
Xu Jingming then opened his personal panel and clicked on the virtual teaching of "Black Turtle Evolution Method".
I saw an illusory body appearing in the canyon, and began to practice the first genetic evolution method "Black Turtle Evolution Method" in front of Xu Jingming.
Xu Jingming decided to try one by one starting from the low level of fit.
"The speed, strength, and rhythm of each move are required, and they must be coordinated with breathing." When Xu Jingming started practicing, he found that it was very difficult.
"The moves are getting faster and faster, and the breathing is getting faster and faster." Xu Jingming breathed in harmony, and felt his heart began to hurt, and the skin all over his body felt burning. He finally reached the middle of the practice.
"Pfft."
Xu Jingming couldn't help but spurt out a mouthful of blood.
"You are already injured." The man in green shirt said.
"This is more abnormal than any exercise method I have ever learned." Xu Jingming covered his chest and clicked on his personal panel to restore his body to its peak state.
In the gaming world, you don’t have to worry about injuries because you can return to your peak condition at any time.
"Its exercise can even cause genetic changes, and eventually transform into a higher level of life." The man in the green shirt said, "Of course it is difficult, so I want you to learn in the virtual world."
"Come again." Xu Jingming tried again.
again and again.
The whole set of movements, from slow to fast, the breathing is getting faster and faster, and the heart is like a pump, working more and more intensely.
Due to various reasons, Xu Jingming failed again and again.
Until the sixth time!
"Hmph." He finally stopped, and the breath coming out of his nostrils was filled with blood. It was blood stains, but Xu Jingming finally completed a complete set of actions.
"Congratulations on mastering the "Black Turtle Evolution Method" to the elementary level. You only practiced it six times. It's really amazing." The man in blue shirt said.
Xu Jingming sighed secretly.
He is one of the world's top martial arts players, and his body control is so precise that he had to practice six times to reach the elementary level. If you are an ordinary person, how many times will you get it? A hundred times? Three hundred times?
"MoreA combat power panel? "Xu Jingming was surprised to find that a sub-column appeared under the personal panel - the combat power panel.
Player: Xu Jingming
Gene Evolution Method: "Black Turtle Evolution Method" (Basic 1%) (Practice time is less than one day, can be improved)
Body: 12 (for adult males who have not learned the evolution method, the average value is 5)
Skills: None (please conduct actual combat as soon as possible to determine skills)
Basic combat power: None (please conduct actual combat as soon as possible)
"The practice time is less than one day, can I improve? "Xu Jingming looked at that line of text.
“In the game world, you don’t need to practice hard over and over again like in reality. As long as you practice regularly, you can push your body to its limit. "The man in green shirt said.
Xu Jingming tried to click Boost.
"Practice the "Black Turtle Evolution Method" three times a day, at least an hour apart each time. After 39 days of practice, your body transforms and evolves, and your body mass index reaches 39. "
"After 1,051 days of practice, your body has evolved to its limit and your body mass index has reached 53. "
"If you want to continue to improve your body, please upgrade the "Black Turtle Evolution Method" to the intermediate level. "
With just a simple click, Xu Jingming felt that his body had transformed. His chest and back were much wider and thicker, his whole body was much stronger, his arms and legs were also stronger, and his movements were extremely powerful.
Xu Jingming picked up a pebble in the canyon and swung it violently. When he threw it out, Xu Jingming felt that his whole body was like a large engineering machine, working tightly and suddenly throwing out the pebble.
The pebbles tore through the air, leaving a wave of air that shattered when it hit the rock wall in the distance, which frightened Xu Jingming.
Xu Jingming picked up another pebble, exerted a little force with his right hand, and wheezed, the pebble was crushed into pieces, and the shards slowly fell from his fingers.
"Can I be like this in reality? "Xu Jingming whispered.
"As your combat power panel reminds you, as long as you practice three times a day, after 1051 days, your real body will be improved to what it is now. "The man in green shirt said, "This is the evolution of human beings. "
"In this martial arts training ground, can I choose any weapons and armors? "Xu Jingming looked at the many functions of the martial arts training ground. You can choose weapons and armors, sparring, and battle scenes. There are many functions.
“Almost every cold weapon in Blue Star’s history is available here. "The man in green shirt explained.
Xu Jingming stretched out his hand and a spear appeared out of thin air: "Heavy, heavier. "The martial arts training ground is specially designed to assist training, and the weight of weapons can also be adjusted freely.
A one-handed thrust from his right hand ripped the air.
Following Xu Jingming, he held the gun in both hands and took a step forward. He held the handle of the gun with his thick left arm and sent it forward, puff puff puff! The spear turned into a phantom and stabbed out more than ten spears in succession, with several spear shadows remaining in the air.
“It’s a bit awkward to use marksmanship. "Xu Jingming looked at his arms, which were twice as thick as before. He was too strong. "This body is too clumsy. "
“The body resets to the physical body. "Xu Jingming clicked lightly, and his body changed rapidly, returning to the state when he first entered the game. He became thinner again, and the leg injuries and scars also returned to his body.
"The next evolution. "Xu Jingming started virtual teaching of "Shadow Leopard Evolution Method" again.
Nowadays, countless people all over the world are seriously studying evolution.
On the martial arts training ground.
Xu Jingming learned the other four evolutionary methods at an astonishing speed.
After learning it five times, he upgraded the "Shadow Leopard Evolution Method" to the basic level. When the practice time increased to three years, Xu Jingming was much leaner than in reality and extremely agile. He could run a 100-meter run in five seconds.
After learning it three times, the "Giant Bear Evolution Method" and "Violent Tiger Evolution Method" have been mastered.
The "Giant Bear Evolution Method" has the greatest impact on the body. After reaching the physical limit, Xu Jingming's height increased to 1.98 meters, and he was so powerful that he looked like an upright bear. After the "Bad Tiger Evolution Method" reached the physical limit, his height reached 1.85 meters and he became a little stronger."You have learned the "Sky Python Evolution Method" after just one practice. The compatibility is indeed 98%." The man in green shirt beside said with emotion.
Xu Jingming increased the practice time of "Sky Python Evolution Method" to 982 days on his personal panel, and also improved his body to the extreme. His height has only increased by one centimeter, but his muscles are much tighter than before and full of endless toughness. His spine is like a big dragon, able to easily transmit the strength of his body.
"Try the gun." Xu Jingming stood in front of the rock wall. He moved the spear in his hand, leaving streaks of gun shadows. The tip of the gun clicked on the canyon rock wall. In the blink of an eye, more than thirty spears were pierced. The hole punched in the rock wall formed a five-pointed star.
Xu Jingming looked at the rock wall with satisfaction: "The deduction in the virtual world is really amazing. The "Sky Python Evolution Method" is indeed the most suitable for me."
"The five evolutionary methods. In terms of strength, it is the Giant Bear Evolution Method. In terms of physical strength, it is the Black Turtle Evolution Method. In terms of strength, flexibility, and flexibility in all aspects, it is the Violent Tiger Evolution Method. The fastest and most flexible one is the Shadow Leopard Evolution Method. But... the one with the strongest physical toughness, and the one that suits me best, is the Sky Python Evolution Method."
"It is also the easiest for me to practice the "Sky Python Evolution Method". I succeeded in one try and the physical improvement was the most obvious." Xu Jingming nodded.
It is also the initial stage of the evolutionary method, after it is upgraded to the limit.
Only the Sky Python evolution method can reach a body index of 63, the violent tiger evolution method is 60, and the other three methods are all over 50. If you practice the female evolution method with a lower degree of compatibility, your body index will probably be even lower.
"As long as practice has not started in reality, the virtual world can be reset at any time." Xu Jingming thought, "Let's tentatively decide on the "Sky Python Evolution Method" and practice it for a few days first."
